# Review Summary

Use this as the review entry point. It is a derived summary, not a new
agreement unit or approval record. Keep details in the linked Canonical and
Evidence documents; do not copy the full Trace history here.

- Consumer import compatibility and structural-budget dispositions:

- Next approval required:
